address: 439 Nong Tao Lek Road, Ban Lueam, Mueang Udon Thani, Udon Thani, 41000, Thailand
bio: The strength of this shop is its locally sourced free-range meat. The tender braised duck noodles, including neck, wing and thigh, are highlights. Their slow-cooked pork is equally exceptional. Try the duck rice with a smooth blood jelly and five spices....
